name: Gurglhof
beschreibung: The Gurglhof is a hotel in Obergurgl in the Ötztal, located at around 1,930 metres above sea level. The house is situated directly at the valley station of the Gurgler Seilbahn and is therefore an ideal starting point for skiers and snowboarders. The hotel's architecture combines traditional alpine elements with contemporary comfort. The amenities include a wellness area with several saunas, a steam bath and a swimming pool. Culinary-wise, the house offers Tyrolean and international dishes, with half board included in the stay. In addition to winter sports, in summer guests can use the hiking and biking trails in the surrounding area directly from the accommodation. The rooms are functionally furnished and usually offer a balcony with mountain views.
